Changes.LogName: Add Bentley's Restaurant Kiosk (placeable big craftable, indoors and outdoors)

{{ModId}}_RestaurantKiosk.Name: {{ModId}}_RestaurantKiosk
{{ModId}}_RestaurantKiosk.Description: An ordering kiosk from Bentley's. Right-click it to order from the Food Shop or the Dessert Shop. Three kiosk-only deals a day: 10% off.

Changes.LogName: Add Restaurant Kiosk crafting recipe (learned at 2 hearts with Bentley)
Letter from Bentley about the kiosk

Entries.{{ModId}}_KioskLetter: Dear @,^You have been a good friend to the restaurant, so I wanted you to be the first to hear: I built an ordering kiosk.^It lets you order from both the Food Shop and the Dessert Shop without coming to the counter. Place it anywhere you like, right-click it, and choose Desserts or Food.^As a thank-you, each day the kiosk gives you three deals of 10% off.^You can craft it now. I put the recipe in your crafting menu: 50 Wood, 5 Iron Bars and 3 Refined Quartz.^^Sincerely,^   -Bentley^Owner, Bentley's Fast Food[#]A new kiosk
